title: Design: A/P Unpaid Invoices Open Balance column and Totals row look native
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop works at two locations, and you compare A/P Unpaid Invoices' Open Balance column and Totals row with Sales By Customer.
  • You are an Admin user (the "Admin" role) working at {Location-A}, your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has open documents in these reports at two locations, {Location-A} and {Location-B}, and you are enrolled at both; {Location-A}'s name comes first in A to Z order.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and {Location-B} is Staging Lethbridge - 4310.
  • Vendor {Vendor-A} has a long name (more than 40 characters) and open documents at both locations on today's date, including a vendor credit (its Transaction Type is the longest).
    For example: {Vendor-A} is ZZAUTOTEST D-16 Northern Alberta Heavy Equipment and Trailer Repair.
  • Starting screen: A/P Unpaid Invoices (Reports, then "A/P Unpaid Invoices" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu; the page title reads "A/P Unpaid Invoices Report") is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu in light theme at 100% zoom, with every group expanded (Expand all).
  • Sales By Customer (Reports, then "Sales By Customer" under PERFORMANCE in the left menu) is open in a second tab of the same window, for comparison.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Look at the "Open Balance" column on the header, the rows and the Totals row, and compare with Sales By Customer.
  2. Compare the Totals row with Sales By Customer's Totals row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: "Open Balance" is pinned to the right edge and bold on the header, every row, every expanded row and the Totals row, as on Sales By Customer.
  • Step 2: the same native totals row style.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11538 (Story 8, Report descriptions and layout)

  • S8-R3: “The headline column (Open Balance; Total on the Summaries) is pinned to the right edge and bold on the header, every row, every expanded row and the Totals row, as on Sales By Customer. At 1440 pixels wide every column of all six reports is visible without scrolling sideways: the customer or vendor name and Transaction Type wrap long values onto a second line, Location wraps only on A/P Detail (nine columns), column headings never wrap, and money, date and number columns never wrap. Narrower than 1440 pixels, the table scrolls sideways under the pinned column.”
  • S8-R4: “The Totals row uses the native totals row style of the newer reports.”
  • Key Decisions, reuse rule: “The reuse rule. Every control on these reports reuses an existing ShopView pattern: the native filter chips, the native totals row and pinned headline column of the newer reports, the existing location-switch prompt, the design system's chevron icon. Nothing new is drawn. Basis: d-reuse-existing-pattern.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 3 "Collapse all and pinned group rows" (board Grouped.dc.html); page 6 "Descriptions and pinned column" (board Layout.dc.html). Compare the screen with the pictures below at 100% zoom; the expected results still come from the PRD quotes above, the pictures give the look and the on-screen labels.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ar-ap-p6-a-p-unpaid-invoices-at-1440-every-column-visible.png: figure "A/P Unpaid Invoices at 1440: every column visible" (This build (after)), board "6. Report descriptions and the pinned headline column"
  • ar-ap-p3-same-on-a-p-unpaid-invoices.png: figure "Same on A/P Unpaid Invoices" (This build (after)), board "3. Collapse all, Expand all and pinned group rows"
  • ar-ap-p6-a-p-detail-scrolled-sideways-light.png: figure "A/P Detail scrolled sideways, light" (Production (before)), board "6. Report descriptions and the pinned headline column" (today's look, for comparison only)

The design's own words:

  • "At 1440 pixels every column fits without sideways scrolling: Date, Location, Transaction Type, No., Vendor Name, Due Date, Past Due, Amount and the pinned, bold Open Balance. Group labels span to the total; text columns wrap. S8-R3." (caption of "A/P Unpaid Invoices at 1440: every column visible")
  • "Vendor rows pin the same way; re-sorting never collapses an open group. S4-R6, S2-R9." (caption of "Same on A/P Unpaid Invoices")
  • "No description anywhere; no column stays in place." (caption of "A/P Detail scrolled sideways, light")

Design note (DR-01): the design shows the Totals row sits on a light-grey band in some pictures (A/R Collection expanded, A/P Detail, A/P Unpaid Invoices, A/R Detail I32) and on the page colour in others (Summaries, I28, the same A/R Detail screen in I30). Closed without a question: PRD S8-R4: "The Totals row uses the native totals row style of the newer reports." The cases compare with Sales By Customer's Totals row; the pictures are not the reference for this one attribute.
